hero.title: Turn your effort into visible progress.
hero.description: Build structured plans, record what you actually completed, and improve without turning every missed target into failure.
hero.note: Designed for real progress—not perfect streaks.

philosophy.title: A partial result is still a real result.
philosophy.description: Ordinary task apps see an unfinished target. SYP sees the effort you made and gives you an honest picture of your progress.

how.title: From intention to measurable execution
how.description: A simple rhythm that keeps your goals practical and your decisions grounded in real data.

understand.title: Record actual effort

goals.title: One progress system. Many kinds of goals.

insights.title: Know what is moving—and what needs attention.
insights.description: SYP’s deterministic engine calculates your progress from your plan and actual records. The same data always produces the same result.

audience.title: Useful for participants. Focused for coaches.

cta.description: Create your first plan and start seeing the effort behind your goals.

hero.title: A practical system for turning intention into progress.
hero.description: SYP connects what you planned with what you actually did. It preserves partial effort, calculates progress consistently, and helps you decide what to do next.

workflow.title: Four steps from goal to insight

plan.title: Create a focused plan
plan.description: Give your goal a clear purpose, timeframe, and outcome. A plan can be personal or assigned from a coach’s reusable template.
plan.example: Example: Improve my IELTS score in twelve weeks.

activities.title: Define measurable activities
activities.description: Break the plan into actions with quantities, units, and schedules that match the goal.
activities.example: Example: Listening for 30 minutes each day.

effort.title: Record what actually happened
effort.description: Enter the real quantity you completed. SYP keeps partial results instead of reducing your day to success or failure.

report.title: Review and make a better next decision
report.description: Compare expected and actual effort across activities, dates, and trends using deterministic reports.
report.example: Example: 170 of 210 planned minutes equals 81% adherence.

engine.title: The Progress Engine owns the numbers.
engine.description: Reports are calculated from stored expectations and actual records. Controllers, coaches, and AI consume the result instead of creating competing calculations.
engine.aria: Plan expectations plus actual records produce a deterministic progress report

partial.title: Partial effort counts
partial.description: Completing 18 of 30 minutes is recorded as meaningful progress—not a binary failure.

deterministic.title: Results stay explainable
deterministic.description: The same plan and records always produce the same report, making every percentage traceable.

control.title: You remain in control
control.description: Coach feedback and AI guidance can inform decisions, but critical data is never changed silently.

coach.title: Coaches add context and accountability.
coach.description: A coach can assign a structured plan, review authorized participant progress, and leave feedback without owning the participant’s records.

ai.title: AI explains data through controlled tools.
ai.description: With explicit consent, the AI coach can inspect read-only progress data and suggest adjustments. The core application continues to work without AI.

cta.title: Plan it. Record it. See your progress.
cta.description: Create a structured plan and turn your next effort into useful information.

hero.title: Everything you need to turn goals into measurable progress.
hero.description: SYP combines flexible planning, honest effort tracking, deterministic reporting, and optional coaching in one focused workspace.
hero.visualAria: Plan, effort, progress, coach, and AI feature overview

catalog.title: Built around execution—not checkboxes
catalog.description: Every capability supports the same principle: record reality, understand it clearly, and make a better next decision.

plans.title: Structured goal plans
plans.description: Create personal plans or accept an independent snapshot assigned from a coach template.
plans.detail: Draft, active, paused, completed, and archived lifecycles.

measurement.title: Flexible measurement
measurement.description: Use time, pages, repetitions, distance, weight, quantities, or a custom unit.

effort.title: Actual effort records
effort.description: Record exactly what happened, including partial progress and multiple entries on one date.
effort.detail: Corrections and recoverable removal preserve integrity.

reports.title: Deterministic reports
reports.description: Compare expected and actual effort by activity across today, this week, or a custom range.
reports.detail: Explainable attainment, adherence, and occurrence counts.

coaching.title: Coach collaboration
coaching.description: Create reusable templates, invite participants, review authorized progress, and leave feedback.
coaching.detail: Participants retain ownership of their records.

ai.title: Controlled AI guidance
ai.description: Ask questions grounded in real plan data through explicit, read-only application tools.
ai.detail: Consent is required and core features work without AI.

partial.title: Your progress is more than done or not done.
partial.description: SYP stores the quantity actually completed, so difficult days still contribute useful information.
partial.multiple: Preserve multiple efforts on the same day
partial.history: Keep expectations effective-dated instead of rewriting history

reporting.title: See achievement without distorting balanced reports.
reporting.description: Attainment shows the full quantity achieved and can exceed 100%. Adherence is capped so one overachieved activity does not hide another weak area.
reporting.breakdown: Complete, partial, missed, and upcoming occurrences
reporting.units: Activity-level reporting keeps incompatible units separate

coaching.title: Structure can be shared without taking away ownership.
coaching.description: An accepted assignment creates an independent participant plan. Future template edits do not silently rewrite it.

trust.title: The application remains useful, private, and understandable.
trust.description: AI and coaching enhance the system without becoming hidden dependencies.

auth.title: Secure sessions
auth.description: Short-lived access tokens and rotating HttpOnly refresh cookies protect authenticated workspaces.

consent.title: Explicit AI consent
consent.description: Relevant progress data is sent for an AI answer only after the user agrees for that request.

independent.title: AI-independent core
independent.description: Plans, records, reports, and coaching continue to work when AI is disabled or unavailable.

cta.title: Build a plan that measures real effort.
cta.description: Start with one goal, one activity, and one honest progress entry.

hero.title: Coach with evidence—not assumptions.
hero.description: Create reusable plan templates, invite participants, review the progress they authorize, and leave focused feedback based on planned versus actual effort.
hero.visualAria: Example coach dashboard showing participant progress

workflow.title: From reusable structure to focused support
workflow.description: SYP keeps assignment, ownership, and progress access explicit at every step.

template.title: Create a plan template
template.description: Define measurable activities, targets, units, and schedules once, then reuse the structure.

invite.title: Invite a participant
invite.description: Send an assignment invitation to an existing participant by email.

accept.title: Participant accepts
accept.description: Acceptance creates an independent draft plan snapshot in the participant's account.

support.title: Review and support
support.description: Inspect deterministic progress reports and leave feedback within the accepted assignment.

template.title: Turn your method into a reusable plan template.
template.description: Give participants a strong starting structure without making every goal identical.
template.units: Use time, pages, distance, repetitions, weight, and custom units.
template.schedules: Set daily, weekly, or selected-day expectations.
template.snapshot: Each accepted assignment becomes an independent plan snapshot.

capabilities.title: Everything needed for structured, human support

reusable.title: Reusable templates
reusable.description: Standardize a proven program while keeping participant plans independent after acceptance.

measurable.title: Measurable execution
measurable.description: Compare expected and actual effort instead of reducing progress to completed or failed.

visibility.title: Authorized visibility
visibility.description: See progress only for participants who accepted your assignment.

feedback.title: Focused feedback
feedback.description: Respond to real records, weak activities, and consistency patterns with useful context.

insights.title: Understand the numbers before starting the conversation.
insights.description: Deterministic reports reveal adherence, partial effort, and weaker activities. You add the judgment, encouragement, and context.
insights.message: Your reading rhythm is improving. Let’s make the listening target smaller and more consistent this week.

boundaries.title: Clear ownership makes coaching safer.
boundaries.description: The platform separates the coach's template from the participant's plan and records.

ownership.title: Participants own their progress
ownership.description: Actual-effort records belong to the participant and are never silently controlled by a coach.

scope.title: Access follows acceptance
scope.description: A coach can review progress only inside an assignment the participant has accepted.

history.title: Template changes stay predictable
history.description: Later template edits do not silently rewrite a participant's independent plan snapshot.

cta.title: Give every coaching conversation better evidence.
cta.description: Create a coach account and turn your program into measurable, participant-owned progress.
